args.title: Retail Returns Logistics — Summary (Bellwether + Companion)
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost center for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth, showing centralization as an effective mitigation strategy.
- Companion piece (subscriber content): reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the original margin, highlighting speed-to-resale as key to profitability.
